sloka: महायज्ञे तदा तस्य वरुणेन महात्मना ।दत्तं धनुर्वरं प्रीत्या तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ ॥ २.११८.३९॥
transliteration: mahāyajñe tadā tasya varuṇena mahātmanā ।dattaṁ dhanurvaraṁ prītyā tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau ॥ 2.118.39॥

translations.english: Magnanimous Varuna out of his affection had given him, on the occasion of a great sacrifice, an excellent bow with inexhaustible arrows and a pair of quivers.
